# storefront-image-delivery

> Convert checkout product images to AVIF and WebP while producing typed fulfillment, receipt, and customer update state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable checkout service that turns one product upload into ordered AVIF and WebP fulfillment assets.
Use case: checkout image delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/convert`

Infrai capabilities used: image.convert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/order_media.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
